We conduct experiments on seven instruction-following benchmarks: • Dolly Evaluation is a sampled test set of the databricks-dolly-15k dataset , consisting of 500 samples. • Self-Instruct ) is a user-oriented instruction-following dataset containing 252 samples. • Vicuna Evaluation  comprises 80 challenging questions designed to evaluate the Vicuna model. • Wizard Evaluation  contains 218 real-world human instructions of varying difficulty across different domains from diverse sources. • Koala  consists of 180 real user queries that span various topics and represent real-world chat system use cases. • Super-Natural Instructions (S-NI)  includes 1,616 diverse NLP tasks with expert-written instructions, covering 76 distinct task types. The test set includes 9,000 samples spanning 119 tasks. • Unnatural Instructions (UnNI)  includes 240K AI-generated instructions with minimal human involvement.
